title: Satan and his angels cast down to Earth before Adam

tellings.quote: they came to the earth or were cast down to the earth a long time ago after that cosmic battle.

plain: Long before Adam, Satan and his angels supposedly came to Earth, or were thrown down to it, after a battle in the heavens. A researcher named Tim Alberino tells Michels this as his reading of the biblical story, without naming a source. If true, fallen beings would have been on Earth before the first humans.
